requirement: Add one rule to a clinical metric: the metric and criterion must exist and be live, the criterion may not repeat within the metric, and the rule must match the metric's existing system (scoring vs major/minor); then map the formula against the clinical variables and persist the rule.

preconditions.text: The target clinical metric exists and is live
The target criterion exists and is live
The metric already carries one live rule of its system
A live clinical variable exists for the score function
A soft-deleted rule already reserves the criterion in the metric

inputs.text: Scoring rule with the constant score function 1
Scoring rule with a ternary age-band formula referencing the AGE variable
Second scoring rule on a metric that already has one
Same criterion used by a different metric
Criterion already reserved by a soft-deleted rule
Add request with an unknown clinical metric ID
Add request with a soft-deleted clinical metric ID
Add request with an unknown criterion ID
Add request with a soft-deleted criterion ID
Criterion already used by a live rule in the metric
Score function referencing an unknown clinical variable
Score function referencing a soft-deleted clinical variable
Score function adding a boolean constant to a number
Command that sets both a score function and IsMajor
Command that sets neither a score function nor IsMajor
Major/minor rule added to an existing scoring metric
Scoring rule added to an existing major/minor metric

returns.text: Success with Created status and the new rule ID
A ScoringRule is persisted with the mapped formula and turns the metric into a scoring system
A MajorMinorRule is persisted with the requested flag and sets the metric system
Failure with BadRequest for a missing, deleted, duplicate, or unresolvable reference
Failure with BusinessRuleViolation when the rule type contradicts the metric system

exception_text: ArgumentException is thrown when the command sets both or neither of the score function and major/minor flag; nothing is persisted
